LESSON: FRACTIONS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers 1.1 Integers (6 lessons) • represent integers on a number line • operati
Topic 1.2: Fractions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Fractions. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we use fractions in real-life situations?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. work out reciprocal of fractions in different situations
2. carry out combined operations on fractions in different situations

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Fractions.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Fractions using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss and use the correct order of operations in fractions,
2. Discuss and carry out operations on fractions from activities such as model shopping and other real-life cases,
3. Citizenship: as the learner discusses and uses the correct order of operations in fractions in some aspects such as populations.
4. Critical thinking and Problem solving: as the learner works out operations on fractions from model shopping activities. Values:
5. Responsibility: as the learner plays games of operations on fractions using IT devices or other resources.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Fractions is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
